(Restorative measures may include flushing with water, administration of antidotes or medication.)"
"... a fluid which under ambient or expected operating conditions is a vapour or produces vapours that can be ignited and continue to burn in air."
"A fluid service in which all of the following apply:
(1) the fluid handled is non-flammable, non-toxic, and not damaging to human tissues;
(3) the design temperature is from -20°F (-29°C) through 366°F  (186°C)."

"A fluid service in which the potential for personnel exposure is judged to be significant and in which a single exposure to a very small quantity of a toxic fluid, caused by leakage, can produce serious irreversible harm to persons on breathing or bodily contact, even when prompt restorative measures are taken."
